content.short: Dirol is a Monad trading aggregator combining DEX liquidity, launchpads and token discovery.
content.description: Dirol is a decentralized exchange on Monad offering token swaps with low fees and real-time price feeds. The interface combines aggregated DEX liquidity with launchpad listings and token discovery, so a trader can find a new token and trade it without leaving the app. Routing draws on the venues available on Monad to price each swap.
content.meta: Swapping, launchpad access and token discovery in one Monad interface for early-market traders.
